text_to_image_prompt: Young adult man, thick wavy curly brown hair, hazel eyes, clean shaven, navy blazer, light blue open-neck shirt, gray straight trousers, brown leather belt and loafers, healthy substantial thighs and calves. Three full-body views in a horizontal row: front, right-facing side profile, back. Same height and scale in each panel. Pure white seamless studio background, soft even daylight, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, accurate cloth weave and shoe leather, realistic photography, no text, no watermark. Maintain natural adult anatomy and consistent identity.
original_prompt: Create a professional photographic character turnaround reference sheet for the SAME person shown in both reference images. Image 1 is the approved body proportions and full outfit; image 2 is the face identity detail. Young adult man, thick wavy curly brown hair, hazel eyes, clean shaven, navy blazer, light blue open-neck shirt, gray straight trousers, brown leather belt and loafers, healthy substantial thighs and calves. Exactly THREE full-body views arranged evenly left-to-right: straight FRONT, exact 90-degree SIDE profile facing to the right, and straight BACK. Same person, SAME outfit, same head size, same limb proportions and overall height in every view. Preserve the approved leg thickness, leg-to-torso ratio, waist and build; no stretching or fashion-model redesign. Neutral standing posture, arms relaxed at sides; full hair and shoes visible in every panel. Natural perspective at eye level; seamless pure white background and subtle floor contact shadows. Unified clean realistic studio photography, detailed skin, hair and natural cloth weave, no painterly or embossed artifacts. Do not add props, change garments, add labels, text or borders. Wide landscape image, ideally 3072x2048 or maximum native available.
